items.reviewNote: The impersonal clause states that fewer than a hundredth of the people remain after ten years. The global proper rester family includes left-over/subsisting, distinct from the exact surface’s staying-in-a-place bank and from the remainder noun. Prepare this source bank on the existing left-over meaning, preserving other mastery. All four impersonal third-person singular predicates are grammatical with a postverbal une petite partie; subsistence rather than arrival, return or disappearance selects reste.
